What You Get With G&C's Content Writing Service
A human-driven process built for depth, accuracy, and conversion, not AI-generated fluff.
Interview-Driven Content Creation Process
We don't hand your topics to freelancers who produce generic articles. Instead, we conduct 60-90 minute recorded interviews with your product managers, sales teams, and customer success experts to extract the unique differentiators, customer pain points, and technical details that only insiders know. This process ensures every piece contains sales-level argumentation that sophisticated B2B buyers notice and trust.
Target Keywords That Actually Convert
Most agencies chase high-volume keywords that drive traffic but no customers. We use our Pain Point SEO framework to start at the bottom of the funnel by targeting product category keywords, comparison terms, alternatives pages, and jobs-to-be-done phrases that reach buyers actively evaluating solutions. These keywords consistently convert 5-7x better than awareness-stage content.
Complete End-to-End Execution, Not Just Recommendations
We handle the entire content creation process from strategy to results: SERP analysis to identify opportunities, expert interviews to extract insights, professional writing and optimization, publishing to your CMS, link building and distribution, and conversion tracking to measure impact. You get finished, published articles that rank and convert—not deliverables that still require project management and execution.
Advanced, Industry-Specific Content That Sells
While competitors publish generic advice that could apply to any tool in your category, we create content that demonstrates your specific product. Through expert interviews, we extract the unique details, workflows, and differentiators that matter to informed buyers. Every article includes product screenshots, feature walkthroughs, and competitive positioning that educates prospects while making the case for your solution.
Human Writers, Not AI Slop
While many agencies rush to replace writers with AI, we've found that AI-generated content lacks the strategic thinking and authentic expertise that converts B2B buyers. Our human writers conduct and learn from expert interviews, craft original arguments, and understand how to position complex products persuasively. AI may assist our research process, but the insights, structure, and positioning come from experienced professionals.
Conversion Tracking That Informs Your Strategy
We don't bury you in traffic reports. We show you which articles drive demos, which keywords convert to trials, and which content influences closed deals through multi-touch attribution. You'll know exactly where to double down, which topics resonate with buyers, and how content contributes to revenue—insights that actually inform your marketing strategy.
SEO + GEO Strategy Using the Same Foundation
LLMs like ChatGPT and Perplexity search Google to recommend products. Our Prioritized GEO framework shows that content ranking for bottom-of-funnel keywords on Google naturally gets cited by AI tools. Your expert interviews and product details become the source material AI uses to recommend your solution to prospects.
Proven Results Across 100+ Clients Since 2016
Since 2016, we've helped B2B SaaS companies generate first-page rankings for bottom of the funnel keywords that convert at 5-7%+. Our clients see measurable pipeline impact from content: demos booked, trials started, deals influenced. Unlike agencies still figuring out what works, we bring nearly a decade of conversion data and ranking results.

Frequently Asked Questions
While competitors rush to automate content creation with AI, we use human writers guided by expert interviews to produce original arguments and insights. Our process starts with 60-90 minute expert interviews to extract your unique positioning, differentiators, and customer insights. Our writers handle the actual writing, structure, positioning, and strategic thinking. We may use AI to assist with research tasks like analyzing competitor content or gathering background information, but we never use AI to draft or generate the content itself.
From initial topic selection to published article typically takes 3-4 weeks. This includes SERP analysis, scheduling and conducting expert interviews, writing and optimization, and your review/approval cycle. We can accelerate this timeline for urgent pieces, but we've found this pace allows for thorough expert interviews and strategic content development. Once we're in a regular publishing schedule and in rhythm with your team, we typically deliver 3-5 finished articles per month.
No, we don't use client writers. Our interview-based process works best with our own writers who are trained in this methodology. Our writers know how to conduct strategic interviews, extract the right insights, structure content for both ranking and conversion, and position products persuasively. That said, if you have strong in-house writers who want to learn our process, we offer a content marketing course that teaches the full methodology.
For SEO rankings, expect 3-6 months to see articles reaching first-page positions, though we've seen faster results for less competitive keywords. For conversions, you may see qualified leads from articles within the first month if they rank quickly or if you promote them to your existing audience. The compounding nature of SEO means results accelerate over time and articles that rank continue generating leads month after month without additional ad spend. We set up conversion tracking from day one so you can see exactly which articles drive results as they gain traction.
Most content agencies optimize for traffic, not conversions. They chase high-volume keywords, hand topics to freelancers who research online, and measure success by page views and rankings. We do the opposite.

We start with bottom-of-funnel keywords that convert at 5-7%+ instead of 1-2%. We conduct expert interviews with your product and sales teams instead of outsourcing to freelancers who Google for research. We track demos and signups instead of vanity metrics. And we handle everything from strategy to publishing instead of delivering keyword lists and expecting you to execute.

We're optimizing for your revenue, not our content volume. While other agencies rush to publish 20 AI-generated articles per month, we focus on creating 3-5 expert-driven pieces that actually rank, convert, and drive measurable business growth.
